answer: Reputation-decay curve pricing. Each new identity starts at zero trust and pays escalating verification fees as it transacts, so a fresh Sybil must fund a costly ramp before reaching useful volume. The cost curve anchors every identity to a rising entry price that only genuine long-run participants amortize. Like a comet burning fuel to climb, an attacker's fleet pays the full ramp cost per fake identity with no shared discount across the grove of clones.
